svg.aria-label: The draft mode of the grant skill. Boxes: Intake agent: the questions of the grant intake (agent); You answer the intake (stop); Structure architect: the outline, in the funder's sections (agent); You confirm the outline (stop); Argument builder: each section's argument for the criteria (agent); Draft writer: the application's .tex, or a patch of a section (agent); Citation compliance: each cited claim, only with a .bib (agent, only when needed); Formatter: the layout of the funder config, only when it states one (agent, only when needed); You pick the writing findings to apply (stop); Draft writer, resumed: the picked findings as one patch (agent, only when needed).

svg.text: Each of the six roles runs from its page of the paper skill, given the funder config and the

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: session's direction. The session counts the application's pages before the draft, applies each

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: patch, compiles the application with the engine the application itself uses and runs

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check_sections.py and check_limits.py before the writing review and again after its patch. A draft

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of one section is checked and reviewed on that section. The run asks which config when the

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: application's folder holds several, asks the mode of a plain request that names none, and passes on

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a stop of the paper skill. A draft of a form field starts the intake agent and the draft writer

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: only, which writes the field's text into grant-fields.md. The config mode starts the config drafter

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and shows you its draft to confirm; for a file of form-field texts you name it asks before it

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: replaces a grant-fields.md that exists, starts the field texts agent when the file is in another

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: format, and shows you the form fields to confirm. The revise mode starts the draft writer on a

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: comments file and ends with the same writing review. The review mode compiles the application and

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: starts the criteria reviewer, which scores it per criterion and changes nothing. The check mode

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: starts no agent: it compiles and runs the two scripts.
